policy: Source citation and file identity are not evidence approval. Unreviewed quantitative claims may remain as attributed context only when the article visibly labels the gap and proposed applications are explicitly not represented as demonstrated outcomes.

not evidence of a validated catalyst, sorbent, commercial process, deployment, or forecast
